#### Professional Background
Lina Andersson is a PhD student in the Department of Pediatrics at Sahlgrenska Academy, University of Gothenburg, Sweden. 

Her research is focused on understanding the molecular mechanisms underlying juvenile idiopathic arthritis. Using methods like flow cytometry, bulk RNA sequencing, and single-cell RNA sequencing, she investigates the cellular and molecular changes in disease development and progression. 

#### Education
Bachelor's degree in Molecular Biology from University of Gothenburg
Master's degree in Molecular Biology from University of Gothenburg. 

#### Personal Interests
In her spare time, Lina enjoys gaming, reading, and cooking.
